playlist.title: YouTube Creation
playlist.evidence_boundary: Playlist membership, public title, public description, public chapter labels, creator attribution, publication date, and public page metadata only. No transcript claim is inferred.

sources.creator: Oscar Owen
sources.title: How To Write A Killer YouTube Script (2025 Algorithm)
sources.public_evidence: The public description identifies a five-step script formula. Its public chapters place an example immediately after the intro, followed by five sequential steps.

sources.creator: Vanessa Lau
sources.title: If I Started a YouTube Channel in 2025, This Is My EXACT Blueprint to Grow.
sources.public_evidence: The public description promises a complete beginner blueprint and names hooks, watch time, content planning, scripting, click-through rate, and sustainable posting as covered topics.

sources.creator: Vanessa Lau
sources.title: YouTube Analytics Explained: How to Read Your Analytics FOR BEGINNERS!
sources.public_evidence: The public title frames the lesson for beginners and makes the practical outcome explicit: reading YouTube analytics.

sources.creator: Katie Steckly
sources.title: The Ultimate Guide to Editing B-Roll For YouTube (FREE!)
sources.public_evidence: The public description and chapters cover matching B-roll to A-roll or voiceover, clip selection, timing, slow motion, cinematic edits, and music.

sources.creator: Liam Ottley
sources.title: 16 Insane AI Lead Generation Systems for 2025 (with PROOF!)
sources.public_evidence: The public title binds the promise to a concrete count and explicitly promises proof. The description links a detailed writeup for the demonstrated solutions.

sources.creator: Vanessa Lau
sources.title: How to Make Thumbnails That Get Views (NO EXPERIENCE NEEDED)
sources.public_evidence: The public chapters move from inspiration and construction through a mobile test, channel mockup, outsourcing, and A/B testing.

sources.creator: Alex Hormozi
sources.title: The Value Equation
sources.public_evidence: The creator-published source names the Value Equation. Acquisition.com's public journal depicts value as dream outcome and perceived likelihood relative to time delay and effort or sacrifice.

sources.creator: Alex Hormozi
sources.title: $100M Journal: Value Equation
sources.public_evidence: The creator-published journal visually defines the four variables used by the Value Equation.

sources.creator: Nick Saraev
sources.title: The next leg
sources.public_evidence: The creator-published article describes using current search demand, topic timing, performance spikes, and longer authoritative courses to guide content selection.

sources.creator: Nick Saraev
sources.title: Nick Saraev / Writer, AI Automation
sources.public_evidence: The creator's public site presents a repeatable roadmap and a library of AI automation education across articles, products, and YouTube resources.
